AAI.name: Accommodation allocation information
AAI.description: To specify the references, the type and the characteristic of accommodations allocated as a result of a reservation request.

ADI.name: Health care claim adjudication information
ADI.description: To provide adjudication information for all services in a health care claim.

AJT.name: Adjustment details
AJT.description: To identify the reason for an adjustment.

ALC.name: Allowance or charge
ALC.description: To identify allowance or charge details.

ALI.name: Additional information
ALI.description: To indicate that special conditions due to the origin, customs preference, fiscal or commercial factors are applicable.

ALS.name: Additional location information
ALS.description: To specify the type of location, the actual location in coded and full name text, and the country code of the location.

APD.name: Additional transport details
APD.description: To convey additional information concerning a means of transport.

APR.name: Additional price information
APR.description: To provide information concerning pricing related to class of trade, price multiplier, and reason for change.

ARD.name: Monetary amount function
ARD.description: To provide details of the function of a monetary amount.

ARR.name: Array information
ARR.description: To contain the data in an array.

ASD.name: Service details
ASD.description: To specify date, time, location and additional characteristic information related to a service.

ASI.name: Array structure identification
ASI.description: To identify the structure of an array.

ATI.name: Tour information
ATI.description: To convey information concerning a tour.

AUT.name: Authentication result
AUT.description: To specify results of the application of an authentication procedure.

BAS.name: Basis
BAS.description: To describe the foundation or starting point.

BGM.name: Beginning of message
BGM.description: To indicate the type and function of a message and to transmit the identifying number.

BII.name: Structure identification
BII.description: A segment used to convey an indexing structure mechanism which identifies the positioning of a group or item.

BLI.name: Billable information
BLI.description: To provide billable information for a claim or encounter.

BUS.name: Business function
BUS.description: To provide information related to the processing and purpose of a financial message.

CAV.name: Characteristic value
CAV.description: To provide the value of a characteristic.

CCD.name: Credit cover details
CCD.description: To request a credit cover, reply to that request and disclose the reason for the reply.

CCI.name: Characteristic/class id
CCI.description: To identify and describe a specific characteristic and its relevance for subsequent business processes.

CDI.name: Physical or logical state
CDI.description: To describe a physical or logical state.

CDS.name: Code set identification
CDS.description: To identify a code set and to give its class and maintenance operation.

CDV.name: Code value definition
CDV.description: To provide information related to a code value.

CED.name: Computer environment details
CED.description: To give a precise definition of all necessary elements belonging to the configuration of a computer system like hardware, firmware, operating system, communication (VANS, network type, protocol, format) and application software.

CIN.name: Clinical information
CIN.description: To describe an item of clinical information.

CLA.name: Clause identification
CLA.description: To identify a clause in a treaty, law and/or contract.

CLI.name: Clinical intervention
CLI.description: To specify a clinical intervention such as treatments and investigations.

CLT.name: Clear terminate information
CLT.description: To specify information required to undo all or part of the previous actions in a business transaction.

CMN.name: Commission information
CMN.description: To specify information about a commission.

CMP.name: Composite data element identification
CMP.description: To identify a composite data element and to give its class and maintenance operation.

CNX.name: Connection details
CNX.description: To specify a connection location, the designated supplier, the associated times, and the travel venue sequence.

CNY.name: Country information
CNY.description: To specify country and related information, i.e. date and time of summer or winter time transition and related time variation, currency and language(s).

COD.name: Component details
COD.description: To provide component details of an object (e.g. product, container) such as its type and the material of which it is composed.

COM.name: Communication contact
COM.description: To identify a communication number of a department or a person to whom communication should be directed.

CON.name: Contact information
CON.description: To specify contact communication numbers and names.

COT.name: Contribution details
COT.description: To specify details about membership contributions.

CPS.name: Consignment packing sequence
CPS.description: To identify the sequence in which physical packing is presented in the consignment, and optionally to identify the hierarchical relationship between packing layers.

CST.name: Customs status of goods
CST.description: To specify goods in terms of customs identities, status and intended use.

CTA.name: Contact information
CTA.description: To identify a person or a department to whom communication should be directed.

CUR.name: Currencies
CUR.description: To specify currencies used in the transaction and relevant details for the rate of exchange.

CUX.name: Currencies
CUX.description: To specify currencies used in the transaction and relevant details for the rate of exchange.

DAM.name: Damage
DAM.description: To specify damage including action taken.

DAV.name: Daily availability
DAV.description: To specify availability on a daily basis.

DII.name: Directory identification
DII.description: To identify a directory and to give its release, status, controlling agency, language and maintenance operation.

DLI.name: Document line identification
DLI.description: To specify the processing mode of a specific line within a referenced document.

DMS.name: Document/message summary
DMS.description: To specify summary information relating to the document/message.

DNT.name: Dental information
DNT.description: To provide specific tooth and oral cavity information.

DOC.name: Document/message details
DOC.description: To identify documents and details directly related to it.

DRD.name: Data representation details
DRD.description: To specify the details of the data representation.

DSG.name: Dosage administration
DSG.description: To communicate how dose(s) are administered.

DTI.name: Date and time information
DTI.description: To specify dates and times, related text and time references.

DTM.name: Date/time/period
DTM.description: To specify date, and/or time, or period.

EFI.name: External file link identification
EFI.description: To specify the link of one non-EDIFACT external file to an EDIFACT message.

ELM.name: Simple data element details
ELM.description: To identify a simple data element and give related details.

ELU.name: Data element usage details
ELU.description: To specify the usage of a data element.

EQA.name: Attached equipment
EQA.description: To specify attached or related equipment.

EQD.name: Equipment details
EQD.description: To identify a unit of equipment.

EQN.name: Number of units
EQN.description: To specify the number of units.

ERC.name: Application error information
ERC.description: To identify the type of application error within a message.

ERI.name: Application error information
ERI.description: To identify the type of application error within a message.

ERP.name: Error point details
ERP.description: A segment to identify the location of an application error within a message.

FII.name: Financial institution information
FII.description: To identify an account and a related financial institution.

FNS.name: Footnote set
FNS.description: To identify a set of footnotes.

FRM.name: Follow-up action
FRM.description: To identify a follow-up action that should occur.

FRQ.name: Frequency
FRQ.description: To specify a frequency and the time window in which it applies.

FSQ.name: Formula sequence
FSQ.description: To provide a single operation within the sequence of operations of a formula.

FTX.name: Free text
FTX.description: To provide free form or coded text information.

GDS.name: Nature of cargo
GDS.description: To indicate the type of cargo as a general classification.

GID.name: Goods item details
GID.description: To indicate totals of a goods item.

GIN.name: Goods identity number
GIN.description: To give specific identification numbers, either as single numbers or ranges.

GIR.name: Related identification numbers
GIR.description: To specify a related set of identification numbers.

GOR.name: Governmental requirements
GOR.description: To indicate the requirement for a specific governmental action and/or procedure or which specific procedure is valid for a specific part of the transport.

GRU.name: Segment group usage details
GRU.description: To specify the usage of a segment group within a message type structure and its maintenance operation.

HAN.name: Handling instructions
HAN.description: To specify handling and where necessary, notify hazards.

HDI.name: Hardware device information
HDI.description: To specify a hardware device line number, level of access, type and characteristics of the device.

HDR.name: Header information
HDR.description: To specify header information applicable to the entire message.

HYN.name: Hierarchy information
HYN.description: A segment to identify hierarchical connections from a given item to a higher or lower levelled item or to identify dependencies among the content of hierarchically related groups of data.

ICI.name: Insurance cover information
ICI.description: To specify a type of insurance, if it is required, and the coverage, limit, and deductible amounts.

IFD.name: Information detail
IFD.description: To specify details about items of information.

IHC.name: Person characteristic
IHC.description: To specify characteristics of a person such as ethnic origin.

IMD.name: Item description
IMD.description: To describe an item in either an industry or free format.

INP.name: Parties and instruction
INP.description: To specify parties to an instruction, the instruction, or both.

INV.name: Inventory management related details
INV.description: To provide the different information related to the inventory management functions and needed to process properly the inventory movements and the inventory balances.

IRQ.name: Information required
IRQ.description: To indicate which information is requested in a responding message.

ITC.name: Institutional claim
ITC.description: To provide specific claim information for services performed while admitted to an institution.

ITD.name: Information type data
ITD.description: To indicate the category of data, the language, and the format of the data.

LIN.name: Line item
LIN.description: To identify a line item and configuration.

LKP.name: Level indication
LKP.description: To indicate a level in a hierarchical structure.

LOC.name: Place/location identification
LOC.description: To identify a place or a location and/or related locations.

MAP.name: Message application product information
MAP.description: To indicate the instruction, the applicable supplier, and the message functions and applications affected.

MEA.name: Measurements
MEA.description: To specify physical measurements, including dimension tolerances, weights and counts.

MKS.name: Market/sales channel information
MKS.description: To specify to which market and/or through which sales distribution channel and/or for which end- use the sales of product/service have been made or are given as forecast.

MOV.name: Car delivery instruction
MOV.description: To specify delivery and chauffeur drive details, including number of passengers and language of passengers for a car.

MSD.name: Message action details
MSD.description: To specify the message and business function and to provide a tracking mechanism.

MSG.name: Message type identification
MSG.description: To identify a message type and to give its class and maintenance operation.

MTD.name: Maintenance operation details
MTD.description: To identify a maintenance operation and its responsible parties.

NAA.name: Name and address
NAA.description: To specify the name/address and their related function, either by E082 only and/or unstructured by E058 or structured by E080 through 3207.

NAD.name: Name and address
NAD.description: To specify the name/address and their related function, either by C082 only and/or unstructured by C058 or structured by C080 thru 3207.

NME.name: Name
NME.description: To identify the name of a person or entity.

NUN.name: Number of units
NUN.description: To specify the number of units required.

ODI.name: Origin and destination details
ODI.description: To convey first the origin and then final destination of a journey.

ODS.name: Additional product details
ODS.description: To specify additional details including the types of product data, the actual data, the number available, and the charges for usage.

ORG.name: Originator of request details
ORG.description: To provide the originator of request details.

OTI.name: Other insurance
OTI.description: To provide payer, insured, and payment information when benefits are being coordinated between third party benefit carriers.

PAC.name: Package
PAC.description: To describe the number and type of packages/physical units.

PAI.name: Payment instructions
PAI.description: To specify the instructions for payment.

PAS.name: Attendance
PAS.description: To specify attendance information relating to an individual.

PAT.name: Payment terms basis
PAT.description: To specify the payment terms basis.

PCC.name: Premium calculation component details
PCC.description: To identify the component affecting a premium calculation and the value category of the component.

PCI.name: Package identification
PCI.description: To specify markings and labels on individual packages or physical units.

PDI.name: Person demographic information
PDI.description: To specify items of person demographic information.

PDT.name: Product information
PDT.description: To specify details related to a product such as configuration and availability.

PER.name: Period related details
PER.description: Specification of details relating to a period.

PGI.name: Product group information
PGI.description: To indicate the group in which a product belongs.

PIA.name: Additional product id
PIA.description: To specify additional or substitutional item identification codes.

PMT.name: Payment information
PMT.description: To specify information concerning the payment.

PNA.name: Party identification
PNA.description: To specify information necessary to establish the identity of a party.

POC.name: Purpose of conveyance call
POC.description: To specify the purpose of the call of the conveyance.

POP.name: Period of operation
POP.description: To specify date or time period with days of operation.

POR.name: Location and/or related time information
POR.description: To provide information about a location, related times and sub-locations.

POS.name: Point of sale information
POS.description: To specify point of sale information by party identification or location identification.

PRT.name: Party information
PRT.description: To provide specific identification number and demographic information regarding the identity of the participating parties.

PRV.name: Proviso details
PRV.description: Details regarding the stipulation or limitation in a document.

PSD.name: Physical sample description
PSD.description: To define the physical sample parameters associated with a test, resulting in discrete measurements.

PSI.name: Service information
PSI.description: To provide detail information about the service.

PTY.name: Priority
PTY.description: The segment is used to communicate priority information.

PYT.name: Payment terms
PYT.description: To specify the terms of payment.

QRS.name: Query and response
QRS.description: To provide a declaration in the form of a coded question and response.

QTI.name: Quantity
QTI.description: To convey information about a quantity.

QUA.name: Qualification
QUA.description: To specify the qualification of a person.

QVR.name: Quantity variances
QVR.description: To specify item details relating to quantity variances.

RCI.name: Reservation control information
RCI.description: To specify a reference to a reservation.

RCS.name: Requirements and conditions
RCS.description: To specify sector/subject requirements and conditions.

ROD.name: Risk object type
ROD.description: To identify a type of object at risk.

RPI.name: Quantity and action details
RPI.description: To indicate quantity and action required in relation to a product.

RSL.name: Result
RSL.description: To specify a discrete or non-discrete result as a value or value range.

RTC.name: Rate types
RTC.description: To specify the types of rates.

RTI.name: Rate details
RTI.description: To identify a rate and to indicate how it should be processed.

RUL.name: Rule information
RUL.description: To specify rule information and rule status.

SCD.name: Structure component definition
SCD.description: To specify a component of a data structure (e.g. an array or table).

SDT.name: Selection details
SDT.description: To specify the details for making a selection.

SEG.name: Segment identification
SEG.description: To identify a segment and give its class and maintenance operation.

SEL.name: Seal number
SEL.description: To specify the seal number or a range of seal numbers.

SEQ.name: Sequence details
SEQ.description: To provide details relating to the sequence.

SER.name: Facility information
SER.description: To provide facility information, followed by the period and days of operation.

SGP.name: Split goods placement
SGP.description: To specify the placement of goods in relation to equipment.

SGU.name: Segment usage details
SGU.description: To specify the details of the usage of a segment within a message type structure.

SPR.name: Organisation classification details
SPR.description: To provide classification details relating to the activities of an organisation.

SPS.name: Sampling parameters for summary statistics
SPS.description: To define the sampling parameters associated with summary statistics reported.

SSR.name: Special requirement details
SSR.description: To specify special requirements on services, the quantity required, action to be taken and where the requirement should be administered.

STA.name: Statistics
STA.description: To transmit summary statistics related to a specified collection of test result values.

STG.name: Stages
STG.description: To provide information related to the kind of stage in a process, the number of stages and the actual stage.

STS.name: Status
STS.description: To specify the status of an object or service, including its category and the reason(s) for the status.

TCE.name: Time and certainty
TCE.description: To specify the time and certainty of an event.

TDI.name: Traveller document information
TDI.description: To specify document information related to a traveller.

TDT.name: Details of transport
TDT.description: To specify the transport details such as mode of transport, means of transport, its conveyance reference number and the identification of the means of transport. The segment may be pointed to by the TPL segment.

TEM.name: Test method
TEM.description: To describe the nature of the test performed.

TFF.name: Tariff information
TFF.description: To specify tariff details relating to a service or product.

TIF.name: Traveller information
TIF.description: To specify traveller(s) and personal details.

TIZ.name: Time zone information
TIZ.description: To provide information about a time zone.

TMD.name: Transport movement details
TMD.description: To specify operational transport movement details for a goods item or equipment (which may differ from the contractual conditions).

TOD.name: Terms of delivery or transport
TOD.description: To specify terms of delivery or transport.

TPL.name: Transport placement
TPL.description: To specify placement of goods or equipment in relation to the transport used. The segment serves as a pointer to the TDT segment group.

TRF.name: Traffic restriction details
TRF.description: To provide details which restrict traffic.

TSR.name: Transport service requirements
TSR.description: To specify the contract and carriage conditions and service and priority requirements for the transport.

TVL.name: Travel product information
TVL.description: To specify details related to a travel product.

UCD.name: Data element error indication
UCD.description: To identify an erroneous stand-alone, composite or component data element, and to identify the nature of the error.

UCF.name: Group response
UCF.description: To identify a group in the subject interchange and to indicate acknowledgement or rejection (action taken) of the UNG and UNE segments, and to identify any error related to these segments. It can also identify errors related to the USA, USC, USD, USH, USR, UST, or USU security segments when they appear at the group level. Depending on the action code, it may also indicate the action taken on the messages and packages within that group.

UCI.name: Interchange response
UCI.description: To identify the subject interchange, to indicate interchange receipt, to indicate acknowledgement or rejection (action taken) of the UNA, UNB and UNZ segments, and to identify any error related to these segments. It can also identify errors related to the USA, USC, USD, USH, USR, UST, or USU security segments when they appear at the interchange level. Depending on the action code, it may also indicate the action taken on the groups, messages, and packages within that interchange.

UCM.name: Message/package response
UCM.description: To identify a message or package in the subject interchange, and to indicate that message's or package's acknowledgement or rejection (action taken), and to identify any error related to the UNH, UNT, UNO, and UNP segments. It can also identify errors related to the USA, USC, USD, USH, USR, UST, or USU security segments when they appear at the message or package level.

UCS.name: Segment error indication
UCS.description: To identify either a segment containing an error or a missing segment, and to identify any error related to the complete segment.

UGH.name: Anti-collision segment group header
UGH.description: To head, identify and specify an anti-collision segment group.

UGT.name: Anti-collision segment group trailer
UGT.description: To end and check the completeness of an anti-collision segment group.

UIB.name: Interactive interchange header
UIB.description: To head and identify an interchange.

UIH.name: Interactive message header
UIH.description: To head, identify and specify a message.

UIR.name: Interactive status
UIR.description: To report the status of the dialogue.

UIT.name: Interactive message trailer
UIT.description: To end and check the completeness of a message.

UIZ.name: Interactive interchange trailer
UIZ.description: To end and check the completeness of an interchange.

UNE.name: Group trailer
UNE.description: To end and check the completeness of a group.

UNG.name: Group header
UNG.description: To head, identify and specify a group of messages and/or packages, which may be used for internal routing and which may contain one or more message types and/or packages.

UNH.name: Message header
UNH.description: To head, identify and specify a message.

UNO.name: Object header
UNO.description: To head, identify and specify an object.

UNP.name: Object trailer
UNP.description: To end and check the completeness of an object.

UNS.name: Section control
UNS.description: To separate header, detail and summary sections of a message.

UNT.name: Message trailer
UNT.description: To end and check the completeness of a message.

UNZ.name: Interchange trailer
UNZ.description: To end and check the completeness of an interchange.

USA.name: Security algorithm
USA.description: To identify a security algorithm, the technical usage made of it, and to contain the technical parameters required.

USB.name: Secured data identification
USB.description: To contain details related to the AUTACK.

USC.name: Certificate
USC.description: To convey the public key and the credentials of its owner.

USD.name: Data encryption header
USD.description: To specify size (i.e. length of data in octets of bits) of encrypted data following the segment terminator of this segment.

USE.name: Security message relation
USE.description: To specify the relation to earlier security messages, such as response to a particular request, or request for a particular answer.

USF.name: Key management function
USF.description: To specify the type of key management function and the status of a corresponding key or certificate.

USH.name: Security header
USH.description: To specify a security mechanism applied to a EDIFACT structure (i.e.: either message/package, group or interchange).

USL.name: Security list status
USL.description: To specify the status of security objects, such as keys or certificates to be delivered in a list, and the corresponding list parameters.

USR.name: Security result
USR.description: To contain the result of the security mechanisms.

UST.name: Security trailer
UST.description: To establish a link between security header and security trailer segment groups.

USU.name: Data encryption trailer
USU.description: To provide a trailer for the encrypted data.

USX.name: Security references
USX.description: To refer to the secured EDIFACT structure and its associated date and time.

USY.name: Security on references
USY.description: To identify the applicable header, and to contain the security result and/or to indicate the possible cause of security rejection for the referred value.

VEH.name: Vehicle
VEH.description: To convey information about a vehicle.

VLI.name: Value list identification
VLI.description: To identify a coded or non coded value list.
